component.name: Safeer OS
component.summary: Your computer in your hands - programs, files and devices on top of Linux

description.p: Safeer OS is a full-screen shell over your existing Linux desktop: programs, files, devices, network, sound and settings in one place, made for a TV-like experience with the keyboard, the mouse or the remote of a Safeer device. Linux Mint stays underneath - one click returns you to the desktop.

ul.li: Safeer Link: apps of your phone, tablet and TV, your computer's sound on them, files across devices - at home, no cloud, no account.
Connect a phone without any Safeer app: scan the code and it opens a small page served by your own Safeer Link.
Name your devices; the name is kept by Safeer Link and shown the same everywhere.
Shield: DNS filtering of ads, trackers and dangerous domains for the whole computer.
Includes Safeer Control (Safeer Link for the computer) in the AppImage and Flatpak bundles.

description.p: Released together with Safeer Control 2.1.63 (security: commands between devices in Safeer Link and their answers are signed with the device key and encrypted from device to device, once both devices run this version). Safeer OS no longer switches on "Start when I sign in" by itself: it starts at sign-in only if you switch that on in Settings. Where an earlier version had switched it on at first start, this update switches it off once. (0.4.64 was prepared but not published.)

Released together with Safeer Control 2.1.61 (security: a device paired into Safeer Link reaches the files, programs, player and screen of this computer only after you open them for that device on this computer). No changes in Safeer OS itself.

Released together with Safeer Control 2.1.60 (the screen of the computer on a phone, tablet or TV uses far less data - at home the picture stays as it was, away from home quality is tuned to an ordinary 4G connection; a program that is already open on the desktop is shown there). No changes in Safeer OS itself.
Released together with Safeer Control 2.1.59 (in full-screen games opened from a phone or tablet, a tap now hits the button). No changes in Safeer OS itself.
Released together with Safeer Control 2.1.58 (programs from this computer fill the screen of the phone, tablet or TV that shows them). No changes in Safeer OS itself.

From this computer to a device that is away from home (Global Link): when the hub of a device is not on this network it is reached through the relay, with the same trust (the key in the certificate must be the key of the circle member). A device without a home network address is read through its hub at once, without a direct attempt that cannot succeed.

Away from home (Global Link) works like at home: the hub of this computer now serves everything its file server serves - files, thumbnails for videos and pictures, renaming, moving and deleting, and streams - with the same token and the same rules.

The screen of one computer can be shown on another computer: the hub of a computer now relays a shared screen. The screen of a phone or tablet opens on the computer instead of an error page. Sharing ends when nobody is watching, and the sender is told why.

A file sent from another computer arrives in the downloads folder. Sharing the screen of this computer with a phone, tablet or TV works again: it starts at the hub of the device that shows it. Two computers in the same network no longer advertise their hub under the same name.

After it starts, the computer is back in Safeer Link sooner: it calls the devices it knows instead of waiting to be found. It tells other devices every address it has on the home network (sound on a device, screen of the computer), and the remote screen tries each of them.

The screen of this computer opens from a phone, tablet or TV again: other devices now get the address of the computer instead of 127.0.0.1. A remote screen no longer drops while the mouse moves, a stuck screen-sharing session no longer blocks the next one, and small messages through Global Link no longer wait for each other.

A device stopped by the Safeer Link defence can be released straight from the notification (button Release), and pairing by code that was closed because of guessing can be reopened from its notification. The buttons work in the notification bubble and later in the notification tray.

The Safeer Link hub defends itself: it counts hostile attempts per device (probing, refused sign-ins, pushing into the Link) and stops a device that exceeds the threshold for 10 minutes, twice as long at every repetition. Guessing the six-digit pairing code is limited for all addresses together: after 20 unsuccessful guesses within an hour pairing by code is closed for one hour, then one day, then one week. Your own devices keep working and a notification tells you what happened.

Files refresh by themselves: the open folder, Recent and Trash update when another program changes them (a finished download, a file copied in the file manager, a file from another device), and a USB stick appears when it is plugged in. Search finds a file that has just been downloaded.
Media centre: a content language choice next to the genre for All, Films, Series, Video and Music. The catalogue no longer waits for a source that does not answer and does not jump while loading.
Programs: the first program in a launcher folder that did not exist yet (the first Flatpak program on a fresh computer) also appears at once.
Programs: a program that is installed or removed while Safeer OS is open appears in the Programs panel and the Programs section at once, without a restart.

New in Network connections: Internet through the phone. A phone with Safeer OS Mobile in Safeer Link can lend its internet connection to this computer - while the home connection is down, or always - without a hotspot. Safeer Link connections on the computer no longer break during large transfers.

Renaming a device works when this computer is the hub, and when a name cannot be saved Safeer OS says why. New: safeerctl, Safeer Link from the command line - devices, what each can do, processor, memory and battery, starting apps, sending files and text - with JSON output for scripts.

In Files, drop a file on a device in the side list to send it - or choose Send to a device from the menu. The device gets a verified copy in its downloads folder; the file on the computer stays where it is. Safeer Control now hands the file to the hub of the receiving device, so sending works now that every device runs its own hub.

The search field on the desktop now also finds Safeer OS itself (its sections and the Shield), your notes and the devices in your Safeer Link, and leads into the Media Centre. Search no longer needs accented letters and accepts several words in any order - for apps, files, notes and the media library alike.

The first film played from a torrent no longer waits in silence: the one-time download of the open-source player program is shown with its progress and can be cancelled, and if it cannot be downloaded Safeer OS says so. The Shield is now tested against a real system before every release.

Files on the desktop surface get "Open with": the programs registered for that type of file, any other program that can open a file, and a tick to make the chosen one the default for the whole desktop. The Shield can now be switched on in the Flatpak package too, and is tested in a real Flatpak sandbox.

Important fix for the Shield (DNS filtering): turning the Shield off, or quitting Safeer OS with the Shield on, could leave the computer without name resolution until the network reconnected. The Shield now hands the network back exactly as NetworkManager set it, really receives the queries, keeps short local names working, starts with the desktop surface too, and leaves computers with their own DNS server alone. New: allow a domain that was just blocked, and pause ad blocking for 15 minutes.

File search finds files at any depth, instantly: Safeer OS keeps the file names of your home folder in memory instead of walking the disk on every letter. Accents no longer matter, several words can come in any order, and the best and most recent matches come first. Safeer OS follows the session language like other programs. With Safeer Control 2.1.40 the Control window no longer pops up by itself when Safeer OS starts.

The computer no longer falls asleep in the middle of a film: while the Safeer player is playing, automatic sleep is held off, and during video the screensaver and screen blanking too. With Safeer Control 2.1.39 the computer also stays awake while another device is watching a film from it. Files on the workspace: undo for move, copy, trash, rename and new items (the Undo button in the notification or Ctrl+Z), and typing the first letters of a name jumps to that file.

Files on the Safeer Cinnamon workspace work like a file manager: select several files (Ctrl, Shift, Ctrl+A) and copy, cut, trash or restore all of them at once; drag files onto a folder to move them (hold Ctrl to copy). Files dragged in from another program are copied into the folder, and files dragged out are accepted by other programs. Notifications are shown above the dock instead of behind it.

On the Safeer Cinnamon workspace, the Larger text and Less transparency switches now drive the system settings (text size; the contrast theme for the shell and for programs) and follow them, instead of keeping their own copies. Released together with Safeer Cinnamon 1.2.0, where you choose the layout: the look only, the look with a dock, or the workspace.

A film starts with a source that works: an expired time-limited link is no longer tried first, and before playback the Media Centre checks that the first source really responds. On the Safeer Cinnamon desktop, Enter in the search field opens the matching program; Shift+Enter searches the web.

Cloud gaming: GeForce NOW appears under Games. One click installs the official NVIDIA package for your user (nothing is installed until you ask), and every game tile says where the game runs: this computer, a device in Safeer Link, or the cloud.

Files on the desktop do the everyday jobs: copy, cut and paste (also Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+V), a Trash view with Restore, USB sticks and other drives with safe removal, Properties, and thumbnails for pictures and videos. Folders with more than 600 items are no longer cut short.

Media keys, headset buttons and the sound applet now see and control the Safeer OS player (MPRIS): play, pause, next, previous, seek, with title and artwork. Safeer from power-on (0.4.34, first published here): the boot and login screen can wear the Safeer look.

Safeer from power-on: with Safeer Cinnamon 1.1.0 the boot screen and the login screen can wear the Safeer look too. One switch in Settings (it asks for the administrator password); turning it off restores exactly what was there before.

Keep: a film on the shelf On your devices that you mark with the bookmark no longer expires after 48 hours. Subtitles from the torrent also arrive when another device streams the film to this computer. Your sources in the Media Centre (add-ons, podcasts, playlists, streams) are now the same on the computer and on your Android devices in Safeer Link; an add-on that marks itself as private stays on the device where you added it. Apps on the desktop: the programs of this computer are listed too, every tile has a star and Favourites is always the first tab.

The shelf On your devices in the Media Centre: films that any device in your Safeer Link has downloaded from a torrent - computer, phone, tablet or TV - with title and poster; the device that keeps the film plays it. A film you watched in Safeer OS on the computer is offered to your other devices too. Titles from a private add-on stay on the computer without title or poster and never appear on the shelf.

Packaged with Safeer Control 2.1.29: a film the computer downloads for your TV, tablet or phone is now remembered with its title and poster, so it appears on the shelf On your devices on all your devices. No changes to Safeer OS itself.

Films that add-ons offer as torrents now play in the Media Centre on the computer: the computer downloads the film and the player starts while it is still downloading. Asking again for a film that is already downloading no longer waits, Safeer OS and Safeer Control can use torrents at the same time, and a film also starts on a slow disk.

Packaged with Safeer Control 2.1.27: films the computer fetched for your TV, tablet or phone are removed automatically once nobody has played them for 48 hours, and Safeer Control no longer slowly accumulates background threads. No changes to Safeer OS itself.

Media Center: the same catalogue as on your other devices - films, series, music, radio and live TV with genres and search, Stremio add-ons and media servers, playlists from YouTube and Spotify. Playlists stay the same on all devices in your Safeer Link.
Web start page: remove any shortcut (built-in ones too) and restore the defaults; update offered from the Safeer Control tray menu.
Updates: Safeer Control offers the update from its tray menu too; the home banner jumps straight to the Updates button; an AppImage is replaced in place.
Updates: the Settings section also tells what is new in the offered version.
Updates: Safeer OS checks safeer.si itself, shows a note on the home screen and installs a new version from Settings with one press (DEB via pkexec, Flatpak, AppImage).

"Playback for other devices" switch next to "Trust this computer" in Safeer Link; "Continue from another device" also as a button in the Media Centre header; the sender is told when the target cannot show a notification (Safeer Control 2.1.20).

Continue from another device on the computer (a card in the Media Centre asks your Link devices what they play or last watched) and Send to device from the player on the computer; the sender is told when the target has notifications switched off (Safeer Control 2.1.19).
Send to device: a phone or TV can send what it is playing to this computer; a quiet Accept/Decline banner appears and Safeer OS continues at the same second only after Accept (Safeer Control 2.1.18).

Continue on another device: your phone or TV can ask what Safeer OS is playing on this computer and continue at the same second (files from shared folders only; Safeer Control 2.1.17). safeer-os --predvajaj opens a file in the player.
The trust circle tidies itself: a device unseen for 90 days is removed from the circle on all devices; sibling identities of live devices stay.
Safeer Control sends Stremio request headers along when it transcodes a stream for a device; a D-Bus call for any Safeer Link command (diagnostics).
The computer now helps devices that cannot play a video: Safeer Control converts it on the fly (VAAPI or CPU) and streams it to them over Safeer Link.

Convert a whole folder for TV: every video gets its own device in Safeer Link, so several devices work at once and the folder is done sooner. The computer streams torrents to devices even while it is busy with other work.

Convert for TV: right click a video in Files and the device in Safeer Link with the best hardware encoder converts it to H.264 up to 1080p, a format every TV plays. The original stays unchanged; you choose whether to copy the converted video next to it or leave it on the device.

Shared space in Safeer Link: when the computer runs low on disk space, Files shows the largest files and can store one on the device in Safeer Link with the most free space. The copy is verified; you see on which device and in which folder it is, and only then decide whether to delete the original.

The Safeer Link window shows every device's spare capacity and whether it can help. A film that is already fully downloaded on the computer is streamed straight from disk to the TV instead of being downloaded again.

Every device in Safeer Link now reports its spare capacity and whether it can help others right now. The computer helps only when it is not busy, has memory and disk space, and – on a laptop – is plugged in or has at least 40 % battery (it stops below 30 %).

Solidarity in Safeer Link: when a weaker device such as a TV opens a torrent from a Stremio add-on, this computer downloads it and streams it to the TV, so nothing is stored on the TV. The computer only takes on the job when it has spare capacity and disk space, and finished downloads can be removed from the TV's media center.

Pairing a new device with the 6-digit code now works on a computer that hosts its own Safeer Link: the code and a QR code with the home network address appear in Connect devices, and the code closes with the window. Files can create a new folder or file (text, document, spreadsheet, presentation or a template) with a right click, rename and move to Trash. New optional Safeer Cinnamon look for Linux Mint with a desktop workspace.

The side bar can be hidden completely and brought back with a handle on the left edge or Ctrl+B. A device removed from your circle of trust loses access to shared files at once, and the local relay port accepts only your own user account.

Magnet links: choose files, watch while downloading and send to your other devices; links from websites or other apps connect only after you press Open, and files that could be programs are marked. Subtitles like in VLC: found next to the video, in a Subs folder, in a torrent or on other devices, fixed automatically, with language choice and an off switch. Unprotected DVDs from an ISO image, a VIDEO_TS folder or the drive; copy-protected discs are not played. Music and video from your other devices play right away, encrypted, also over Global Link.

Safeer Media: your own library of music, videos and photos from your folders (files stay where they are), albums with next and previous, background music, a built-in video player with full screen and resume, a photo gallery, and TV and radio streams with clear error messages. Safeer Link without a single hub: every device connects directly to the others, and a third device passes messages on when two cannot reach each other. Sound to network speakers (DLNA), the web with tabs, and a collapsible side bar.
New Messages section: email (IMAP/SMTP) and Chatwoot in one list with one conversation per person, and Safeer Chat between your own devices in Safeer Link – delivered later if a device is offline.

New side bar (Home, Media center, Safeer Link, Programs, Files, Web, Notes, Settings), smart search that opens web, files, programs or media in the right section, notes, the web inside Safeer OS, program icons from all devices, and games from another computer shown full screen. Safeer OS opens in a window; the new safeer-os-tema package makes it your desktop on Linux Mint.

The Shield never blocks system and Safeer updates and only accepts block lists from the server that was asked; lists are written safely to disk. Includes Safeer Control 2.1.1: the TV remote controls media players on the separate TV screen.

Fix: no more crash when listing open windows; the Linux Mint panel is always restored after an abnormal end and Safeer OS starts in safe mode after repeated crashes. The bar and the desktop follow a change of screen (laptop lid closed with a TV attached).

First packaged release of Safeer OS for Linux (.deb, AppImage, Flatpak): programs, files, devices, network, sound, Shield; Safeer Link Web for phones without Safeer; device names shared by all devices; sign-in of the computer with a QR code, no cloud.
